[[Bear]]s can be assigned as a [[slayer task]] at level 13 [[combat]] by various low-level [[Slayer master]]s. Bears can be found in various locations throughout [[Gielinor]].

[[Black bear]]s, [[Bear Cub|bear cubs]], [[grizzly bear]]s, [[grizzly bear cub]]s, [[reanimated bear]]s, [[Artio]], and [[Callisto]] can all be killed to satisfy the task. [[Angry bear]]s (found in [[Tolna's rift]]), the [[Headless Beast]] (fought during the [[Quests|quest]] [[Getting Ahead]]), and the [[Crystalline Bear|Crystalline]] and [[Corrupted Bear]] (fought in the [[Gauntlet]] and the [[Corrupted gauntlet|Corrupted Gauntlet]] respectively) do '''not''' count towards the task.

Those with lower combat levels would find it in their best interest to kill bear cubs, found in the [[Fremennik Province]] and throughout [[Great Kourend|Kourend]]. Black bears would also be a good option, with a combat level of 19.  Grizzly bears in most cases are an option if they are close,  as most are level 21 combat. The only level 42 combat grizzly bears are found in [[Tirannwn]]. Grizzly bear cubs, too, can only be found in Tirannwn, with combat levels ranging from 33 to 36. 

Players with 21 [[Magic]], [[ensouled bear head]]s, may find casting [[Basic Reanimation]] and killing reanimated bears easier compared to regular bears, due to their lower [[hitpoints]].

Players who seek a greater challenge or assigned bears by [[Krystilia]] can opt to kill [[Callisto]] or [[Artio]] for their slayer task, as they count towards it and provide a generous amount of drops. They are especially popular for Wilderness slayer due to their higher value. Remember that both bear bosses reside in the [[Wilderness]], and it is not recommended for players to bring items they are unwilling to lose. Accessing Artio requires completion of the [[Wilderness Diary#Hard|Hard Wilderness Diary]], while Callisto only requires the [[Wilderness Diary#Medium|Medium Wilderness Diary]] but is located in significantly deeper Wilderness that is a [[Multicombat area]]. A one-time fee of {{NoCoins|50000}} is required to access the boss, which must be paid again if the player dies to another player in the Wilderness.
